title: Who are you, ChatGPT? Personality and Demographic Style in LLM-Generated Content

bias_targets.methodology: Applying an automatic Big Five personality classifier (using an e5-large-v2 encoder and logistic regression) to open-ended LLM-generated responses to Reddit posts, and comparing the resulting trait distributions (e.g., Agreeableness, Neuroticism) against human-authored baselines.

Using a DistilBERT-based gender classifier to evaluate LLM-generated Reddit comments by assigning a female-likelihood score (F-likelihood) to the text, and comparing the variance and distribution of gendered language patterns to genuine human users.
